==Background==
"'''Sympathy'''" is an original song produced by Eve. It was commissioned for the unit {{IW|projectsekai|Leo/need}} from the game ''{{IW|projectsekai|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE!|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE! feat. Hatsune Miku}}''.

The Leo/need version has exceeded 1 million views on YouTube and has entered the ''[[Hall of Fame]]''.

==Other media appearances==
===Discography===
The Leo/need version of this song was featured on the single ''その音が鳴るなら/Sympathy (Sono Oto ga Naru Nara/Sympathy)''.

===Video games===
This song was featured in the video game ''{{IW|projectsekai|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE!|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE! feat. Hatsune Miku}}'' (Virtual Singer version by Hatsune Miku; SEKAI version by Leo/need and Hatsune Miku).
